about: What a file is as a report (docs/reports-design.md §1, §2), one answer per case: `expected` is `grid`, `linear`, or `null` for no report. The server's one tag reader must give it for the compiled file, for the same text read uncompiled, and as the layout `lintNotebookText` lints the file as (report_layout_parity.spec.ts). The SDK's tag reader gives it too, and the builder opens any case it can open with that layout (readDocument.spec.ts).

cases.name: `layout=grid` with tiles is grid
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=grid tiles=["s -> v"] }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: `layout=linear` with no tiles is the retired cell format: no report
a tag naming no layout and listing no tiles is the retired cell format: no report
a tiles list with no layout is grid
cases.source:
## artifact { tiles=["s -> v"] }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: an empty tiles list with no layout is grid
cases.source:
## artifact { tiles=[] }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: a `dashboard { … }` grid tag on the artifact line is grid
cases.source:
## artifact { } dashboard { columns=6 }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: a `## dashboard { … }` grid tag on its own line is grid
`layout=linear` wins over a tiles list
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=linear tiles=["s -> v"] }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: an unknown `layout=` falls through to the tiles list
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=wide tiles=["s -> v"] }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: a tiles list of only a text tile is grid
`layout=grid` with no tiles is grid
`layout=linear` wins over a grid width
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=linear tiles=["s -> v"] } dashboard { columns=12 }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: an unknown `layout=` with no tiles falls through to linear, and with no tiles is no report
a `##|` block tag is read like a one-line tag
a tag after another property on its line
cases.source:
## title="x" artifact { layout=grid tiles=["s -> v"] }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: `kind=dashboard` is no longer read: no report
cases.source:
## artifact { kind=dashboard tiles=["s -> v"] }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: `kind=notebook` is no longer read: no report
`kind=` beside `layout=` still makes no report
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=grid kind=notebook }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: a model-level tag that does not parse is no report
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=grid tiles=[ }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: a query-level `# artifact` on a named query is no report
a query-level `# artifact { … }` with properties is no report
`# artifact` on a `run:` statement is no report
a model-level tag naming no layout beside a query-level `# artifact` lists no tiles: no report
a file with no artifact tag is no report
cases.source: source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }

cases.name: a `tiles` that is not a list is a tag the reader cannot use: no report
cases.source:
## artifact { layout=linear tiles=foo }
source: s is duckdb.sql("select 1 as x") extend { view: v is { group_by: x } }
